newsitem.title: USA: FPC's Crystal River nuke reduces power.
newsitem.headline: FPC's Crystal River nuke reduces power.

text.p: Florida Power Corp's (FPC) 825 megawatt (MW) Crystal River 3 nuclear power unit reduced power over the weekend for water pump maintenance, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The unit, located at Red Level, Fla., was operating at 85 percent of capacity as of early Monday morning, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Power at the unit was "reduced for circulation water pump maintenance," the NRC said. An FPC spokeswoman could not immediately comment on the power reduction.
FPC is a subsidiary of Florida Progress Corp.
